name: Advanced Web Application Attack
description: A sophisticated attacker is exploiting a SQL injection vulnerability in the web application to extract database contents, then uses a web shell for persistence and pivots into the internal network.
objective: Detect the SQL injection attack, identify the web shell, remove persistent access, and assess database compromise.

events.message: SQL injection detected: GET /api/users?id=1+UNION+SELECT+username,password+FROM+admin_users-- HTTP/1.1 from 45.33.32.156
Malicious file upload: /uploads/image_2024.php (PHP web shell) uploaded via POST /api/upload
Pivot attempt: web-app-01 (10.0.2.10) scanning internal subnet 10.0.1.0/24 via web shell

hints: SQL injection with UNION SELECT is trying to extract data from other tables
Web shell uploads create persistent access — find and remove the file
Web shells can be used to pivot into internal networks
Check the uploads directory for any PHP or executable files
